description: A Flutter widget called ScoreBar that displays the scores for players X and O, shows current game status, and updates dynamically based on game state.

classes.name: ScoreBar
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays the current scores of X and O along with game status information.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the ScoreBar, including score pills and game status display.
